description: Phase 6ca — AGG(DISTINCT constant) dedup inside a SELECT DISTINCT wrapper. Regression for compile_select_distinct losing the agg_distinct flag when splicing the inner program, which caused SUM(DISTINCT -10) to return -30 on a 3-row table.

cases.name: sum-distinct-constant-under-select-distinct
cases.description: SUM(DISTINCT -10) over 3 rows should still be -10 even when wrapped in SELECT DISTINCT.

cases.name: sum-distinct-constant-plus-offset
cases.description: Exact shape that slt_good_0.test line 18126 exercises.

program.sql: SELECT DISTINCT + SUM(DISTINCT -10) + 63 FROM tab2 AS cor0;

cases.name: count-distinct-constant-under-select-distinct
cases.description: COUNT(DISTINCT -10) over N rows must be 1 (constant deduped); then SELECT DISTINCT picks the single 1 row.

cases.name: count-distinct-null-under-select-distinct
cases.description: COUNT(DISTINCT NULL) is 0 regardless of row count; SELECT DISTINCT doesn't change that.

program.sql: SELECT DISTINCT COUNT(DISTINCT NULL) FROM t;
SELECT DISTINCT SUM(DISTINCT NULL) FROM t;

cases.name: min-distinct-constant-under-select-distinct
cases.description: MIN(DISTINCT c) = c — DISTINCT is a no-op for MIN but must still not error and must still produce the constant.

cases.name: avg-distinct-constant-under-select-distinct
cases.description: AVG(DISTINCT c) over N rows = c (constant deduped → single value → avg is itself).

cases.name: sum-distinct-column-with-duplicates-under-select-distinct
cases.description: SUM(DISTINCT a) over [1,1,2,3] must be 6 (1+2+3), independent of the outer DISTINCT.

program.sql: SELECT DISTINCT SUM(DISTINCT a) FROM t;
